## Objective

Records are archived or deleted under the class rules, and deletion reaches the object store and backups.

## Scope

As stated in the objective and acceptance criteria; nothing beyond them.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] K2 records carry a review date and one without it is flagged
- [ ] purge is a tier 2 act that needs a bound owner approval
- [ ] deletion propagates to the object store and is reflected in later backups
- [ ] dry-run lists what would be removed and changes nothing

## Test requirements

Integration tests with synthetic data.
